reviews.name: Eurostat
reviews.note: Founding year, parent (European Commission), languages and the public Statistics API were found. The About us, History and Web services pages do not state a headquarters location. The site does not say how jobs get in; the Job opportunities page was linked but not read. The public-open reading rests on the phrase open for public use; no key requirement is mentioned. The 1952 year comes from the timeline heading on the History page.

reviews.name: Jobtoday
reviews.note: HQ (New York, US) was found on the Contacts page. Languages (English, Español) come from the language menu. Business model is free posting with a paid subscription to contact candidates; no prices shown. The About page says we launched but gives no year. The advertise-for-free footer names JobToday S.A. as copyright holder, but no parent relationship is stated, so parent was not recorded. The .it page was not read.

reviews.name: Education Canada
reviews.note: Advertise, employer, about and contact pages were read. Advertising is listed as banners and a job newsletter with no prices; the employer page is a login only. The About page says the site is part of a growing global family of education e-recruitment websites but does not name a parent. No location or founding year was stated. The footer copyright range 2001 - 2026 is not a founding statement.

reviews.name: Built In
reviews.note: Our Story says more than 15 years but gives no founding year and no headquarters. The membership page offers a demo booking and a free AI Reputation Dashboard; it shows no prices or per-post fees for job posting.
